data.problem: Thinking effort/option triggers an error when using model opencode/kimi-k2.5. Need to determine whether the model is misdefined (reasoning/interleaved flags), whether thinking options are incorrectly mapped for openai-compatible providers, or whether kimi-specific enablement is missing.
constraints: Bundled models snapshot does not include kimi-k2.5; runtime data may differ.
Agent thinking options are only mapped for specific SDK providers (not openai-compatible/opencode).
Kimi-specific enable_thinking is only set for kimi-k2-thinking today.

options.name: Verify opencode/kimi-k2.5 model definition
options.approach: Inspect live models.dev data or cached models.json to confirm whether kimi-k2.5 exists, its reasoning/interleaved flags, and any model-specific options. Compare with snapshot and existing kimi-k2/kimi-k2-thinking entries.
options.what_we_learn: Whether the model is actually marked reasoning/interleaved, and if the repo snapshot is stale or missing k2.5-specific metadata.

options.name: Trace request options for thinking-enabled k2.5
options.approach: Reproduce the error with opencode/kimi-k2.5 and thinking/variant enabled. Capture the built request options/body (providerOptions + params) and compare against a non-thinking run or kimi-k2-thinking.
options.what_we_learn: Which options are being sent when thinking is enabled and which parameter causes the error (e.g., reasoningEffort vs missing chat_template_args).

options.name: Hypothesis test: disable or remap thinking for k2.5
options.approach: Temporarily disable variants for k2.5 or add chat_template_args.enable_thinking when thinking is enabled, then re-run to see if error disappears. This isolates whether Kimi needs explicit thinking enablement or variant suppression.
options.what_we_learn: Whether the failure is tied to reasoningEffort being sent or to missing Kimi-specific enable_thinking flags.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium—requires local changes but is reversible.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it is the fastest way to confirm whether opencode/kimi-k2.5 is correctly defined and whether its reasoning/interleaved flags or metadata are mismatched, which directly influences how thinking options are applied.
